_doc: Art-QC lessons ledger (Layer 3 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-21-art-qc-autolearning-design.md). PROTOCOL: every human or critic rejection of a visual becomes one entry here (capture), then a deterministic rule in src/play/artLint.js when computable, else a rubric line for the render critic (promote), then a golden case in scripts/test-art-lint.mjs (pin). promotedTo=null is visible debt. This file is the memory that makes art QC stricter every time something slips — the same LESSONS->GOLDEN-RULES mechanic that hardened the hockey-logic side.

lessons.description: Freeze frames must be readable: tokens that visually merge at the decision moment, anything drawn off the sheet.
Cue labels must point at the read without covering an actor, and stay short for U13-and-under.
The freeze must show the problem, never the solution: no pass/shot arrow or cue marker on the correct answer's target before the learner answers.
